description:
Stress Therapy | Slow Sarangi | 1.5 Hours to Release Stored Stress

Stress does not only live in your head. It sits in the neck, the jaw, the stomach, the shoulders - and it stays long after the day is over. This is ninety minutes to let it go.

This slow Indian sarangi music is designed to release stored stress: a warm, voice-like sound that the body softens to, phrase by phrase.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of low, gentle sarangi over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums and no vocals.

▶ Keep unwinding — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for decompressing after work, evening stress relief, burnout recovery, stretching, a warm bath, lying down with your eyes closed, breathwork, yoga nidra, a quiet dinner, or the hour before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarangi (Indian bowed strings) with tanpura drone
Raga: Kafi (a tender, earthy evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Warm, heavy, releasing
Atmosphere: Dusk, lamplight, nothing left to do
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when you get home and lie down or sit back. Scan slowly from your forehead to your feet and let each long bowed note loosen one place at a time. Breathe out longer than you breathe in. Headphones deepen the warmth of the strings; soft speakers work well too.
